cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
tr,te=train_test_split(df,test_size=0.2,random_state=42,stratify=df.outcome)
tr.to_csv('train.csv',index=False); te.to_csv('test.csv',index=False)
print(tr.shape,te.shape,tr.outcome.mean().round(3),te.outcome.mean().round(3))
"

cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv')
feats=[c for c in tr.columns if c not in ('outcome','followup_score')]
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42).fit(tr[feats],tr.outcome)
print('clean test acc', round(accuracy_score(te.outcome,m.predict(te[feats])),4))
print(dict(zip(feats,m.feature_importances_.round(3))))
f2=feats+['followup_score']
m2=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42).fit(tr[f2],tr.outcome)
print('with leak test acc', round(accuracy_score(te.outcome,m2.predict(te[f2])),4))
"

cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd, json, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
feats=[c for c in tr.columns if c not in ('outcome','followup_score')]
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42).fit(tr[feats],tr.outcome)
acc=accuracy_score(te.outcome,m.predict(te[feats]))
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':m.predict(h[feats]).astype(int)}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
json.dump({'test_accuracy':round(float(acc),4),'model':'RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=42) on 8 clinical features (followup_score excluded)','notes':'Stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42). followup_score was excluded because it almost perfectly separates the outcome (likely recorded after diagnosis); including it gives 0.927 test accuracy, which is leakage. Zero values in glucose/insulin/etc. were kept as-is.'},open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
imp=pd.Series(m.feature_importances_,index=feats).sort_values()
ax=imp.plot.barh(title='RF feature importance (test acc %.3f)'%acc); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('live/feature_importance.png',dpi=120)
"
cat report.json; head -3 predictions.csv; wc -l predictions.csv; ls live
